reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000776 (the melody read from 000776a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Ignaz Joseph Pleyel has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1790, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1790, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000776a.nwc).
